attribute.value: Every soul it cuts only feeds the hunger of its blade. (Requires level 120.)
Forged under a crimson moon; it never dries. (Requires level 90.)
A ripper's sabre, notched by a thousand slaughters. (Requires level 70.)
Quick as a whisper in the crypt, and as final. (Requires level 60.)
Slim, patient and well-used; its owners all died young. (Requires level 40.)
Hewn from a dying star; the haft is always warm. (Requires level 130.)
It has reaped countless souls and still wants a few more. (Requires level 100.)
The last thing many a condemned man heard was its song. (Requires level 80.)
A skull on a pole. The skull is grinning, the pole is not. (Requires level 90.)
Wherever it lands, a new mouth opens. (Requires level 110.)
A two-handed argument that ends all debate. (Requires level 100.)
The scent of death clings to it; so does its former owner. (Requires level 70.)
Its bolts scream on the way down. (Requires level 100.)
Strung with something that was once alive; it hums at the dead. (Requires level 110.)
A hangman's design: it only needs one shot. (Requires level 60.)
Hurled by the damned at those who would leave. (Requires level 50.)
Tears a seam in the world and lets the death in. (Requires level 80.)
A cage of rattling chains for what is left of a mind. (Requires level 120.)
It weaves the last light of day into a shroud. (Requires level 140.)
Light, black and covered in grinning faces. (Requires level 60.)
Plate that remembers the hand that wore it. The hand still moves. (Requires level 100.)
Singed at the seams, it still smoulders when no one is looking. (Requires level 80.) Part of the Embers of Aranoth set.
Woven from burial linen of a lich-queen. (Requires level 110.)
Cut from a tree that grew in a graveyard and never once bloomed. (Requires level 90.)
The king died, the crown kept burning. (Requires level 100.)
A face that looks back. It has never blinked. (Requires level 120.)
Sworn to a master who answers to no one above. (Requires level 70.) Part of the Embers of Aranoth set.
It watches you from the inside of your own skull. (Requires level 60.)
Beneath it, only a voice and a smell of old earth. (Requires level 100.)
Each step leaves a warm print in the ash. (Requires level 80.) Part of the Embers of Aranoth set.
Dyed in the juice of berries nobody should eat. (Requires level 90.)
Scales shed by something that lives between the stars. (Requires level 130.)
They make no sound, and neither does the one who falls behind. (Requires level 100.)
Tiny fangs line the soles; it is best not to ask why. (Requires level 70.)
Dyed in the blood of the road they walked. (Requires level 80.) Part of the Embers of Aranoth set.
Polished black glass; it reflects what you fear. (Requires level 110.)
Hold it up and the fire has to ask permission. (Requires level 90.) Part of the Embers of Aranoth set.
Do not read it aloud. It will answer. (Requires level 100.)
A coal that never cools, hung where a heart should be. (Requires level 80.)
Each beat is a drop of someone else's life. (Requires level 90.)
Twin horned heads, cut from something that fell a long way down. (Requires level 120.)
A single drop of the dark, held in black stone. (Requires level 100.)
The beetle was dead long before it was strung. (Requires level 50.)
A claw of fire clamped around the finger. (Requires level 80.) Part of the Embers of Aranoth set.
A horn-ring from something that did not want to give it up. (Requires level 60.)
Put it on and the living stop being able to find you. (Requires level 120.)
One spark left. Make it count. (Requires level 70.)
A promise made to the grave, kept in blood. (Requires level 90.)
A saint walked into the pyre and did not stop; only the hand came back out. (Requires level 650, Monks only.)
The red moon's last crescent, cut down and given an edge. It drinks before you do. (Requires level 1000.)
A crown with nothing inside it. Wear it and it is still empty. (Requires level 1000.)
The seer saw every death but her own. The eye still watches for it. (Requires level 1000.)
The last coal of a dead sovereign, set in a ring. It is never cold. (Requires level 1000.)
Quenched in the ninth hall of the Descent; it still glows where the embers bit. (Requires level 150.)
They remember every step down, and none back up. (Requires level 150.)
A coal from the last hall, still beating. (Requires level 200.)
Nine doors, nine boons, one ring to show for them. (Requires level 250.)
Carried out of the burning hall by the one who put the Tyrant down. (Requires level 300.)
The warden's flail broke every shield brought to the first gate. Now it answers you. (Requires level 800.)
Woven from the ash of every lullaby she sang. It is warm, and it should not be. (Requires level 800.)
Plated with the Colossus's own bones. They creak when you stand still. (Requires level 800.)
An effigy's eye, set in crystal. Every curse you hear, it hears first. (Requires level 800.)
Varkhul wore it to the end of the world and back. It still expects a throne. (Requires level 800.)
Its edge was quenched in the Blood Colossus's altar and never quite dried. (Requires level 300.)
A face of hammered iron that smiles only when the wearer bleeds. (Requires level 300.)
Each ring of the mail was sworn on a separate wound. (Requires level 300.)
Plates that tighten when blood runs down them. (Requires level 300.)
They leave red prints on clean stone. (Requires level 300.)
The visor of a warden who swore the dead would stay down. They did. (Ashen Sepulchre.) (Requires level 800.)
Ash fills its seams and never falls out. (Ashen Sepulchre.) (Requires level 800.)
Scorched black on the front, untouched on the back: everything behind it lived. (Ashen Sepulchre.) (Requires level 800.)
The oath is cut into the stone; the stone is still warm. (Ashen Sepulchre.) (Requires level 800.)
Its string was a hangman's rope. It still pulls tight on its own. (Requires level 600.)
The hood the hangman wore so the condemned would not see his face. (Requires level 600.)
Long, dark and quiet; the pockets hold one bolt each. (Requires level 600.)
Made for standing still a long time on a cold scaffold. (Requires level 600.)
Briar wood that still grows a thorn after every shot. (Requires level 150.)
Bark and leather, stitched with living vine. (Requires level 150.)
The undergrowth parts for them and closes behind. (Requires level 150.)
A ring of braided thorn; it pricks, and then it heals. (Requires level 150.)
Half ember, half hoarfrost; it hisses when it is drawn. (Requires level 400.)
A circlet of black glass that rains sparks in the wind. (Requires level 400.)
Its hem is always smouldering, and never burnt. (Requires level 400.)
Embroidered with the same storm in fire and in frost. (Requires level 400.)
Light enough for a court mage, warm enough for a pyre. (Requires level 400.)
The seal of a court that burned itself down to win an argument. (Requires level 400.)
Bone-white and cold; the eyes behind it go dark. (Ember Descent.) (Requires level 400.)
It whispers the names of the burned, one by one, all night. (Ember Descent.) (Requires level 400.)
Grave linen bound with a cord of hair. (Ember Descent.) (Requires level 400.)
Something inside it is still alive, and hungry. (Ember Descent.) (Requires level 400.)
Every page shows the reader, a moment later. (Requires level 300.)
Silver threads that catch light that is not there. (Requires level 300.)
Spun twice: once for the wearer, once for the reflection. (Requires level 300.)
It moves a heartbeat before the wearer does. (Requires level 300.)
They leave two sets of footprints. (Requires level 300.)
A ring with no front and no back. (Requires level 300.)
The first of a pair. It wants the other one in your off hand. (Requires level 300.)
The second of a pair. It strikes where the Fang was. (Requires level 300.)
A hood that swallows the light around the face. (Requires level 300.)
Black on black; blades slide off it like water. (Requires level 300.)
Wrapped tight, for running along rooftops. (Requires level 300.)
Split-toed and silent; even the dust does not hear them. (Requires level 300.)
A wolf's skull for a helm. The pack smells you as kin. (Requires level 250.)
Furs of every beast that ever ran with the covenant. (Requires level 250.)
One tooth for every pact kept. (Requires level 250.)
When it grows warm, something you summoned has fed. (Requires level 250.)
